<h2>Assess sjSDM Candidate Guardrails</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Compares a tuning candidate with its reference across tuning repeats and an
independent fold-local refit.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>evaluate_sjsdm_candidate_guardrails(
  data_tuning_summary = NULL,
  data_candidate_repeat_metrics = NULL,
  data_reference_repeat_metrics = NULL,
  candidate_id = NULL,
  reference_candidate_id = NULL,
  maximum_discrimination_decrease = 0.01,
  minimum_tjur_r2 = 0.1
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_tuning_summary">data_tuning_summary</code></td>
<td>
<p>Repeat-by-candidate tuning summary.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_repeat_metrics">data_candidate_repeat_metrics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate repeat metrics from [summarise_sjsdm_fold_metrics()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_reference_repeat_metrics">data_reference_repeat_metrics</code></td>
<td>
<p>Reference repeat metrics with the same schema as the candidate metrics.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="candidate_id">candidate_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Candidate identifier to assess.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="reference_candidate_id">reference_candidate_id</code></td>
<td>
<p>Reference identifier used for comparison.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="maximum_discrimination_decrease">maximum_discrimination_decrease</code></td>
<td>
<p>Largest allowed repeat-level decrease in AUC or Tjur R2. Defaults to '0.01'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="minimum_tjur_r2">minimum_tjur_r2</code></td>
<td>
<p>Minimum candidate mean fold-macro Tjur R2. Defaults to '0.1'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Acceptance requires lower tuning NLL in every repeat, tuning AUC within the
discrimination tolerance, non-inferior independent-refit AUC, Tjur R2, log
loss, and Brier score in every repeat, and the scientific Tjur R2 gate.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing tuning-repeat comparisons, independent-refit
comparisons, and a one-row guardrail summary.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
evaluate_sjsdm_candidate_guardrails(
  data_tuning_summary = data_tuning,
  data_candidate_repeat_metrics = data_candidate_metrics,
  data_reference_repeat_metrics = data_reference_metrics,
  candidate_id = "candidate_002",
  reference_candidate_id = "candidate_001"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
